name: Translate to Slovenian
description: A voice speaks what you say in Slovenian. Needs speech recognition and AI voices. Downloads a 133 MB translation model and voice once, when you ask for it; translating then happens on this PC.
credits: English to Slovenian model from the Argos Translate package index: OPUS-MT (Tiedemann & Thottingal, 2020), CC BY 4.0. Voice: Piper voice sl_SI-artur-medium from rhasspy/piper-voices, CC BY 4.0.
